determination: The original artifact proves the driver did not observe the short-lived success banner within its save wait. It does not show whether the save succeeded, was rejected, remained pending, or the driver missed the banner. Source shows SaveAsPattern sets the banner after savePattern resolves and closes the popover 1200 ms later; the original driver's only save oracle was a 100 ms poll for that transient banner. Product versus driver cause in the original run remains unresolved; no native D47 verdict follows from it.
change: The driver now records a bounded save observation before the click and during the save wait, while the panel is still open. It records name match, save button presence and disabled state, saving indicator, success banner, and categorized visible error without raw text or entered values. It accepts banner or normal popover close only as a signal to check the durable result, then opens Patterns and requires the unique recipe name to be present before starting replay. A visible save error cannot satisfy the terminal condition. This repairs the weak toast-only driver oracle and preserves the first useful failure boundary in the next native receipt.
